scope: Fixed full-f positive-weight quadrature PIC cases only. Seed SE is conditional on deterministic velocity quadrature; it is not iid-particle Monte Carlo uncertainty or an N^-1/2 claim. Root and independent linear Volterra fixed-window estimators qualify before PIC. Later two-stream trapping/saturation is diagnostic,not quantitatively benchmarked. Nyquist charge is reported separately from resolved Gauss; no clipping/retry.
